findings.title: RC-pinned native dependency vs. prefer-stable convention
findings.problem: Pins a release-candidate while the project convention favors pinned stable versions. The design already instructs the implementer to verify and prefer a non-RC stable at install time, so the risk is owned.
findings.fix: At install, run `npm view react-native-bluetooth-classic versions --json`, pick the highest stable (non-rc/beta) release that supports RN 0.81 / New Architecture, fall back to 1.73.0-rc.12 only if no stable exists, keep the exact pin, and record the resolved version in the PR.

findings.title: app.json plugin option key is version-dependent and unverified
findings.where: design.md §1 (a) Register the config plugin — bluetoothAlwaysPermission option key
findings.problem: Exact plugin option keys depend on the installed plugin version. The design flags this and provides a bare-string fallback, so it is a to-confirm step, not a reasoning gap.
findings.fix: After npm install, confirm accepted option keys against node_modules/react-native-bluetooth-classic/app.plugin.js; if the plugin injects descriptions automatically, use the bare "react-native-bluetooth-classic" string form.
